name: Google Flood Hub
description: Ingests river gauge flood status and forecasts, flash flood events and significant flood events from the Google Flood Forecasting API for a configured region and posts them to the map as colour-coded gauge points and impact polygons.

permissions.description: Submits river gauge points and flash flood / significant event polygons to CloudTAK

schedule.description: Polls the Google Flood Forecasting API for updated gauge flood status, flash floods and significant events on a schedule.
